name: Sensei Da-isuki 2
source: The protagonist is a college teacher who is tasked by the academy to investigate the current state of the junior girls dormitory. Four girls that are currently residing in the dorm are not happy about it, but they can't go against the directors wishes. While living together, the teacher and the girls get closer...
